# save_index { #dyf.save_index }

```python
save_index(
    classifier,
    path,
    embeddings=None,
    include_embeddings=True,
    metadata=None,
)
```

Save a fitted classifier's index to safetensors format.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name               | Type                                                                      | Description                                               | Default    |
|--------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| classifier         |                                                                           | Fitted OutlierClassifier instance                         | _required_ |
| path               | [Union](`typing.Union`)\[[str](`str`), [Path](`pathlib.Path`)\]           | Output file path (.safetensors)                           | _required_ |
| embeddings         | [Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`)\] | Original embeddings (required if include_embeddings=True) | `None`     |
| include_embeddings | [bool](`bool`)                                                            | Whether to include embeddings in the file                 | `True`     |

## Example {.doc-section .doc-section-example}

>>> classifier.fit(embeddings)
>>> save_index(classifier, 'index.safetensors', embeddings)
